Dialogs.Dialog: By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
What kind of TV does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ usually watch？
TV？ Why？
I feel like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ doesn't watch the shows normal girls do.
...I'm normal.
Right, sorry. Then variety shows, dramas, that kind of thing？
Those aren't allowed at my house, though...
Not allowed!?
My father doesn't like them. Is that strange？
No, well... Who knows？ So, only news and documentaries？
I watch lots of other things too？ Quiz shows, sumo...
(Sumo...？)
Um... Is that strange？
(Her channels seem kind of lopsided...)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
What foods do you like？ Any you don't？
Likes and dislikes？ Not really.
I see. But you must have had some as a kid, right？ Like hating shiitake？
Did I... Oh, vanilla ice cream！
Vanilla ice cream？ Why？
You know the big tubs？ I loved those. In grade school...
No matter how much they told me not to, I couldn't resist, and when I was home alone, I secretly ate the whole thing.
You ate the whole cup!?
Yes. Then I got a stomachache, Mama scolded me so much, and I hated it for a while.
I see...
I'm fine with it now？
(Maybe ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is the type who gets carried away easily...)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ play any sports besides tennis？
Sports？ Hmm... In grade school I took swimming lessons, though.
Ah, lots of kids did. How well can you swim？
Breaststroke, as far as you like. I did long-distance swimming too.
Whoa！ Then when we go swimming, show me your breaststroke.
Huh？ Hmm... No.
Why？
Because the breaststroke pose is embarrassing. It's kind of like a frog...
Is it really？
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
What kind of music does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like？
Music？ Piano concertos, I guess.
Concer... Oh, uh, huh...
Um, I like piano pieces. I take lessons.
Ah, I see, okay.
...Is it weird？
No, not weird. What about J-pop and that kind of thing？
Of course I listen to it！
Right！ Like who？
Huh？ You know, the one... always on TV. The man with a beard, um, the rock guy.
A beard？ Hm？ Who's that？
Maybe he shaved his beard！ You know, him. I know who it is.
(Could she... be faking it？)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ have any hobbies？ Outside of club, I mean.
Yes. What do you think？
Um... Cooking, baking sweets, that kind of thing？
...How did you know？ Is it that ordinary？
No, lots of girls say cooking is their hobby, but I bet ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s is the real deal.
Really？ Hehe... You know, ever since I was little, I only got halfway with whatever I learned. Studying, sports too.
What!?
But baking sweets is the one thing I'm confident about. Taste-test for me next time？
Any requests？ Cake, Japanese sweets, baked goods, anything？ Hehe▼
("Halfway." What are ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s standards... Am I going to be okay？)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ have a favorite animal？
Favorite animal？ Hmm... Rabbits, I guess.
Rabbits, huh. What do you like about them？
Their tails. They're fluffy, right？ And...
Unlike dogs or cats, they turn away when you call them, but then suddenly they're snuggling up to you. I love that.
Huh... That's what you like？
Yes. It's like, "You little rascal！" Hehe▼
I see. Then...
And how their mouths are always munching. They're gluttons. Hehe▼
(▲高嶺＊＊▲'s favorite animal: rabbits...)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
I might have asked before, but is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ taking over the hospital？
Probably...
When I was little, I wanted to run a cake shop.
A cake shop？
People come to a hospital looking so pained, right？ But cake shop customers are all smiling and happy.
So when I was little, I always thought I'd rather run a cake shop than be a doctor.
I see... But being a doctor's an important job too, right？ Not that you need me to tell you.
Of course. Until recently, I always thought it was the most important job, saving lives.
But now... I just want the person I love to think, "I'm happy because Manaka's here." I want to make them happy.
I must be a bad daughter. I only think about myself.
Being able to think like that... I think ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is amazing.
No... But thank you. If you say so, then I... No, never mind.
(Making someone important happy... I need to think about my future properly too.)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
What's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s dream for the future？
My dream for the future... It might not be a dream, really.
Hm？
My parents run a clinic, right？ So I have to take it over. I'm their only daughter.
A doctor... ▲高嶺＊＊▲ could totally do it, yeah.
You think so？ Why？
Well, you're smart, serious, and kind to everyone.
I'm not that good a girl. Actually... Actually, I'm always thinking selfish things.
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
Is there a woman ▲高嶺＊＊▲ looks up to？
Someone I look up to... Florence Nightingale, I think.
Nightingale, like the mother of the "angels in white," right？
Yes. But she wasn't just charitable. She was rational, intellectual, and strict, with an iron will.
I see... So ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wants to be like her？
Until a little while ago... But lately I'm not so sure.
I realized I'm not that special a person. I'm just an ordinary girl.
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
Is there a woman ▲高嶺＊＊▲ looks up to？
Yes, lots.
Oh？ Like who？
Hmm... The closest one is Mama, I guess.
Huh... Are all girls like that？
Maybe. But my Mama really is amazing.
Her cooking is delicious. She's always smiling, even when she's tired. She scolds me sometimes, though.
When Mama catches a cold and stays in bed, the whole house seems gloomy.
I'd like to be a mom like Mama... Just saying.
Oh no, I sound like a little kid, don't I？ How embarrassing.
(I see. She's probably a lot like ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
Is there a woman ▲高嶺＊＊▲ looks up to？
Of course.
Oh？ Who？
There's a cake shop nearby my family has gone to for years. The owner.
When she was about our age, she went to France alone to train.
Wow, that's amazing...
Right？ Compared to me, I wonder how she did it. She was so brave.
I'm sure her family objected, and she worried about the language...
Even so, having something you just have to do... I think that's wonderful.
I see. So she's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s ideal？
Yes. I started baking sweets to copy her. ...Now you know.
(Training in France... Could I do that？ ...No, I couldn't.)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
What kind of movies does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ like？
Movies？ Let's see...
Don't tell me, historical documentaries？
...Is that bad？
Wait... I got it right!?
Wrong. What I like is... Never mind. I won't say.
What, what？
You won't laugh？
I won't！
I like Cinderella, Snow White, that kind of...
Princesses and princes... like that？
Yes, because they're wonderful, and they have proper happy endings...
You just laughed... Geez, that's why I didn't want to say！ Liar！
(Sorry...)
By the way...
Takane
Yeah. What is it？
Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲ read much？
Books？ Hmm... I haven't read much lately.
I see. What did you used to read？
I loved Sherlock Holmes, and boy-detective stories... I read them a lot on the way to and from lessons.
Mysteries, huh. Those are addictive.
Watson, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.
What, I'm Watson？
Hehe！ They were fun. Maybe I'll read them again.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ must have really loved them.)
